feeds.title: Anya's Reviews
feeds.description: Your guide to looking and feeling your best in minimalist footwear. Find detailed barefoot shoe reviews, complete lists by category, and more. Hi, I am Anya, I first discovered barefoot shoes after a long history of foot issues. By changing my footwear and strengthening my body I was able to completely transform my life.

feeds.title: Barefoot Wandering and Writing
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Thea Gavin. Barefoot Wandering and Writing showcases the journey of Connecting to Wild Orange County and Beyond which began in 2010, and where it has given me great joy to record some of my favorite trips. The goal of sharing all these 'foot-selfies' is to inspire readers to question conventional wisdom and for readers to discover for themselves how overwhelmingly awesome it is to enjoy the interaction of earth and our strong-and-capable feet.

feeds.title: Natural Running Center Blog
feeds.description: For those who are curious about the idea of barefoot running, we aim to highlight in our blog the updates and reviews of barefoot shoes that are coming to the marketplace. The Natural Running Center (NRC) was launched to serve as a comprehensive web resource of information and education for all runners. NRC is a virtual home for new 're-evolution' in running.

feeds.title: Barefoot Run Review Blog
feeds.description: We present our visitors with a review and comparison of several barefoot shoes commercially available through our blogs. Learn to feel the ground again. Hi, I'm Nick, and I'm here to help you on your barefoot journey.

feeds.title: BarefootRunning.com
feeds.description: This website was established in 1997 May by Ken Bob Saxton and focuses more on providing general information, testimonials, and links to more specific information.

feeds.title: Barefoot Strong Blog
feeds.description: The blog is all about how can you can take care of your foot while practicing barefoot running. Barefoot strong by Dr. Emily Splichal. As a Podiatrist, Human Movement Specialist, and Global Leader in Barefoot Science and Rehabilitation, Dr. Splichal has developed a keen eye for movement dysfunction and neuromuscular control during gait.

feeds.title: Natural Running Canada
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jeff Stapleton, designer of the Squat/Scoot method of mid-foot running and a minimalist running workshop/seminar leader. We intend to teach how a runner can have injury-free running in the barefoot way. From this site, you can find Natural, Minimalist, Barefoot Running Coach in Ontario, Canada.

feeds.title: Born to Live Barefoot
feeds.description: Hi, My name is Kriss Sands in 2003 I began living barefoot, all the time and everywhere. I've been very active in promoting the benefits of barefooting as well as debunking various myths. The purpose of this blog is to provide useful information in support of anyone who loves going barefoot, whether occasionally, frequently, or all the time.

feeds.title: The Barefoot Movement Blog
feeds.description: I'm Paul Thompson, a Podiatrist of 10 years, my approach to foot posture and optimal foundation health is different from what a lot of other products and practitioners can offer. I am passionate about teaching you to build a body that supports itself and to increase the longevity of your joints whilst reducing your need for orthotics.

feeds.title: OzBarefoot Blog
feeds.description: Peter and Martina are from Slovakia the country where the Be Lenka shoes are made and distributed to over 60 countries around the world. Discover the benefits of natural walking with OzBarefoot's Barefoot Shoes. Experience maximum comfort and style with our wide range.

feeds.title: Barefoot Julian Blog
feeds.description: Julian is the creator of BarefootJulian. He has created this blog to help explain the benefits of barefoot running and wearing barefoot shoes and also how best to go about making the transition from normal shoes and also to tell the story of how the human race can rediscover its most valuable long-lost treasure - the magic of going barefoot.

feeds.title: John's Barefoot Running Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm John Yohe. My interest lies in writing, books, fiction, poetry, creative nonfiction, essays, running, travel, and Barefoot Running, therefore I have created this blog to write about my experiences and adventures, as well as the barefoot lifestyle in general.

feeds.title: Clan Barefoot Blog
feeds.description: Together transitioning the world to a barefoot life, one step at a time. Hi, I'm Benji! I am a backpacker, hiker, runner, and all-around adventure seeker. I am passionate about helping you live the happiest life you can by teaching you to transition to barefoot living. Check out the blog and start your journey today!

feeds.title: Blootsvoetsgeschoeid
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Marianne and I am glad to take you through my journey. It started about 4 years ago. My goal is to let knowledge about healthy feet and healthy footwear become widespread! And that minimalist shoes may become the standard.

feeds.title: Xero Shoes » Barefoot Running
feeds.description: In this category, we focus on teaching our readers the benefits of Barefoot Running. Steven and Lena are husband and wife and life-long entrepreneurs. We want your feet to move naturally and create footwear that lets do enjoy that, anywhere, any time, at any age. We make products like shoes, boots, and sandals which your feet will ever love!
